sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_metadata" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lineage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_epoch" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (next_sequence > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo' CHECK (status IN ('todo', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'cancelled')), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (priority BETWEEN 0 AND 3), "due_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (due_kind IN ('none', 'date', 'timed')), "due_date" TEXT, "due_instant" INTEGER, "due_zone" TEXT, "due_wall_time" TEXT, "estimate_minutes" INTEGER CHECK (estimate_minutes > 0), "occurrence_id" TEXT UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER, "deleted_at" INTEGER, CHECK((status = 'completed')=(completed_at IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((due_kind = 'none' AND due_date IS NULL AND due_instant IS NULL AND due_zone IS NULL AND due_wall_time IS NULL)OR(due_kind = 'date' AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND length(due_date) = 10 AND due_instant IS NULL AND due_zone IS NULL AND due_wall_time IS NULL)OR(due_kind = 'timed' AND due_date IS NULL AND due_instant IS NOT NULL AND due_zone IS NOT NULL AND due_wall_time IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE INDEX tasks_status ON tasks (status, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX tasks_due ON tasks (due_date, due_instant)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_tags" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id), "removed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (removed IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY(task_id, tag_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "milestones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 0), "completed_at" INTEGER, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX milestones_parent ON milestones (task_id, position, id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "template_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurrence_series(id), "rule_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "engine_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (engine_version > 0), "tzdata_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "cutoff_ordinal" INTEGER CHECK (cutoff_ordinal >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occurrence_state" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "segment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurrence_segments(id), "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ordinal >= 0), "original_slot" TEXT NOT NULL, "overrides_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "skip_reason" TEXT, UNIQUE(segment_id, ordinal));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "task_id" TEXT REFERENCES tasks(id), "series_id" TEXT REFERENCES recurrence_series(id), "rule_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, CHECK((task_id IS NULL)!=(series_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "snoozes" ("task_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id), "until_instant" INTEGER NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0), "suppressed_through" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_views" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "spec_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (spec_version > 0), "spec_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_shadow" ("entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "versions_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (sequence > 0), "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "envelope_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local' CHECK (state IN ('local', 'pending', 'sending', 'acknowledged', 'conflict', 'rejected')), "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0), "retry_at" INTEGER, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_checkpoint" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1), "server_epoch" TEXT, "cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cursor >= 0), "bootstrap_token" TEXT, "bootstrap_page" INTEGER, "last_success" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "detail_json" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tombstones" ("entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER, "deleted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_dirty" ("entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (generation > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_notifications" ("logical_key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "os_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "registration_state" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_journal" ("source_lineage" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source_lineage, source_id));
